Bench-ready protocol for extracting microbial DNA from up to 0.25 g soil with the QIAGEN DNeasy PowerLyzer PowerSoil Kit.

<div class="facts">
<div class="fact"><strong>Format</strong><span>Individual spin columns</span></div>
<div class="fact"><strong>Input</strong><span>Up to 0.25 g soil</span></div>
<div class="fact"><strong>Elution</strong><span>100 uL</span></div>
<div class="fact"><strong>Total elapsed</strong><span>~30 min</span></div>
</div>

---

## Before Starting

::: {.alert .alert-warning role="alert"}
**Prepare the kit**

- Perform every centrifugation step at room temperature (15-25 deg C).
- If Solution C1 contains precipitate, heat it at 60 deg C until the precipitate dissolves.
- Shake Solution C4 thoroughly before use.
- Ensure that PowerBead Tubes rotate freely in the centrifuge; do not exceed 10,000 x g.

:::
::: {.alert .alert-danger role="alert"}
**Chemical safety**

Solution C5 contains ethanol and is flammable. PowerBead Solution and Solution C4 contain guanidine salts. Do not add bleach or acidic solutions directly to waste containing these reagents.

:::
::: {.alert .alert-info role="alert"}
**Choose the lysis setting**

The vendor's starting setting is 4,000 rpm for 45 s for clay soils and 2,500 rpm for 45 s for loose, granular, or high-organic soils on a PowerLyzer 24. Record the setting used for each extraction batch.

:::
---

## Materials

**Kit reagents**

- PowerBead Solution
- Solution C1
- Solution C2
- Solution C3
- Solution C4
- Solution C5
- Solution C6

**Kit hardware**

- PowerBead Tubes, Glass 0.1 mm
- MB Spin Columns
- 2 mL Collection Tubes

**Equipment**

- PowerLyzer 24 Homogenizer or another validated bead homogenizer
- Microcentrifuge capable of 10,000 x g
- Pipettes covering 60-750 uL volumes
- Optional: Vortex-Genie 2 and 24-place Vortex Adapter (cat. no. 13000-V1-24)

---

## Part A: Lysis and Clarification

*~10-15 min*

<ul class="checklist">
  <li><input type="checkbox"><span>Add up to <strong>0.25 g soil</strong> to a PowerBead Tube.</span></li>
  <li><input type="checkbox"><span>Add <strong>750 uL PowerBead Solution</strong> and <strong>60 uL Solution C1</strong>. Invert several times or vortex briefly.</span></li>
  <li><input type="checkbox"><span>Homogenize using the validated setting for the soil. For a PowerLyzer 24, use <strong>4,000 rpm for 45 s</strong> for clay soils or <strong>2,500 rpm for 45 s</strong> for loose, granular, or high-organic soils. Alternatively, secure tubes horizontally in the 24-place Vortex Adapter and vortex at maximum speed for <strong>10 min</strong>; for more than 12 preps, extend vortexing by 5-10 min.</span></li>
  <li><input type="checkbox"><span>Centrifuge at room temperature for <strong>30 s at 10,000 x g</strong>. For clay soils or an incompletely pelleted sample, centrifuge for <strong>3 min at 10,000 x g</strong>.</span></li>
  <li><input type="checkbox"><span>Transfer the supernatant to a clean 2 mL Collection Tube. Expect approximately <strong>400-500 uL</strong>; some soil particles may remain.</span></li>
</ul>

---

## Part B: Inhibitor Removal and DNA Binding

*~15-20 min*

<ul class="checklist">
  <li><input type="checkbox"><span>Add <strong>250 uL Solution C2</strong>, vortex for <strong>5 s</strong>, and incubate at <strong>2-8 deg C for 5 min</strong>.</span></li>
  <li><input type="checkbox"><span>Centrifuge for <strong>1 min at 10,000 x g</strong>. Without disturbing the pellet, transfer up to <strong>600 uL supernatant</strong> to a clean 2 mL Collection Tube.</span></li>
  <li><input type="checkbox"><span>Add <strong>200 uL Solution C3</strong>, vortex briefly, and incubate at <strong>2-8 deg C for 5 min</strong>.</span></li>
  <li><input type="checkbox"><span>Centrifuge for <strong>1 min at 10,000 x g</strong>. Without disturbing the pellet, transfer up to <strong>750 uL supernatant</strong> to a clean 2 mL Collection Tube.</span></li>
  <li><input type="checkbox"><span>Add <strong>1,200 uL Solution C4</strong> and vortex for <strong>5 s</strong>.</span></li>
  <li><input type="checkbox"><span>Load <strong>675 uL</strong> onto an MB Spin Column. Centrifuge for <strong>1 min at 10,000 x g</strong> and discard the flow-through. Repeat with a second 675 uL load, then load and centrifuge the remaining mixture. Three loads are required.</span></li>
</ul>

::: {.alert .alert-info role="alert"}
**Validated workflow note**

The vendor states that the 5 min incubations after Solution C2 and Solution C3 may be omitted. Retain them when continuing an extraction workflow that was previously validated with these incubations.

:::
---

## Part C: Wash and Elute DNA

*~5 min*

<ul class="checklist">
  <li><input type="checkbox"><span>Add <strong>500 uL Solution C5</strong> to the MB Spin Column and centrifuge for <strong>30 s at 10,000 x g</strong>.</span></li>
  <li><input type="checkbox"><span>Discard the flow-through and centrifuge again for <strong>1 min at 10,000 x g</strong> to remove residual wash solution.</span></li>
  <li><input type="checkbox"><span>Place the MB Spin Column in a clean 2 mL Collection Tube without splashing Solution C5 onto the column.</span></li>
  <li><input type="checkbox"><span>Add <strong>100 uL Solution C6</strong> to the center of the white filter membrane. Centrifuge for <strong>30 s at 10,000 x g</strong>.</span></li>
  <li><input type="checkbox"><span>Discard the MB Spin Column. The eluate contains DNA ready for downstream applications.</span></li>
</ul>

::: {.alert .alert-success role="alert"}
**Storage**

Store eluted DNA frozen at -20 to -80 deg C. Solution C6 does not contain EDTA; avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles.

:::

## Stop Points

::: {.alert .alert-danger role="alert"}
**Stop and ask before:**

- Using a bead-homogenization setting that has not been validated for the sample type.
- Continuing if the sample is not pelleted after the specified centrifugation step and the needed clarification time is uncertain.
- Disturbing or transferring an inhibitor-removal pellet.
- Skipping the second post-wash centrifugation, because residual ethanol from Solution C5 can inhibit downstream DNA applications.
- Processing an extraction batch without complete sample identification or the recorded lysis setting.

:::
---

<script>
(function () {
  const notes = document.getElementById("labNotes");
  const clearButton = document.getElementById("clearNotes");
  const status = document.getElementById("notesStatus");
  const storageKey = "dna-extraction-powerlyzer-powersoil-notes";

  if (!notes || !clearButton) return;

  notes.value = localStorage.getItem(storageKey) || "";
  notes.addEventListener("input", function () {
    localStorage.setItem(storageKey, notes.value);
    if (status) status.textContent = "Notes saved locally in this browser.";
  });

  clearButton.addEventListener("click", function () {
    notes.value = "";
    localStorage.removeItem(storageKey);
    if (status) status.textContent = "Notes cleared from this browser.";
  });
})();
</script>
